name: Home-Assistant-Matter-Hub-Alpha
description: Home-Assistant-Matter-Hub (HAMH) publishes Home Assistant entities as Matter devices, so Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and other Matter controllers can use them. Alpha release (tag alpha): gets every fix and feature first and may break. Keeps its data apart from the stable template. Run only one of the two, both use port 8482 and the Matter ports on the host network.

variables.name: Home Assistant URL
variables.description: URL of your Home Assistant, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123

variables.name: Access token
variables.description: Long-lived access token, created in Home Assistant under your profile, Security tab

variables.name: mDNS interface
variables.description: LAN interface of this server, e.g. eth0 or br0. Leave empty unless controllers show the devices as offline.

variables.name: Web UI user
variables.description: Basic auth for the web UI, off while user or password is empty

variables.name: Web UI password
variables.description: Password for the web UI user

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: silly, debug, info, notice, warn, error or fatal
